factchecktools.source: https://developers.google.com/fact-check/tools/api/reference/rest/v1alpha1/pages/create (Authorization scopes: "Requires the following OAuth scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/factchecktools"; the same on the get, list, update and delete pages)
factchecktools.reason: gsearch sends an API key, never an OAuth token, so the ClaimReview page methods are expected to be refused. Not checked live.

methods.factchecktools.pages.create: Google requires an OAuth token with the factchecktools scope for this method; this server sends only an API key, so Google is expected to refuse it.
methods.factchecktools.pages.delete: Google requires an OAuth token with the factchecktools scope for this method; this server sends only an API key, so Google is expected to refuse it.

webrisk.source: https://docs.cloud.google.com/web-risk/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.submissions/create ("Only allowlisted projects can use this method during Early Access."; Authorization scopes: cloud-platform) and https://docs.cloud.google.com/web-risk/docs/submission-api ("We no longer accept new contracts or expansions for the Web Risk Submission API."; its example sends an OAuth access token)
webrisk.reason: Submissions are for allowlisted projects only and take an OAuth token, and the operations methods follow a submission; gsearch sends an API key only. Not checked live.

methods.webrisk.projects.submissions.create: Google: "Only allowlisted projects can use this method during Early Access." The Submission API takes no new contracts, and Google's example sends an OAuth token; this server sends only an API key, so expect a refusal.
methods.webrisk.projects.operations.get: The operations of Web Risk submissions (projects.submissions.create), which only allowlisted projects can make; Google lists an OAuth scope for this method, and this server sends only an API key.
methods.webrisk.projects.operations.list: The operations of Web Risk submissions (projects.submissions.create), which only allowlisted projects can make; this server sends only an API key.
methods.webrisk.projects.operations.cancel: The operations of Web Risk submissions (projects.submissions.create), which only allowlisted projects can make; this server sends only an API key.
methods.webrisk.projects.operations.delete: The operations of Web Risk submissions (projects.submissions.create), which only allowlisted projects can make; this server sends only an API key.
